package.name: dissipative_planner
package.description: The load planner with detach and attach: a subclass of mpc_planner's LoadPlanner that changes the fleet size mid-flight (n -> n-1, n -> n+1), either by resizing the OCP or through the dissipative virtual-node spring-damper network ported from Quan et al., "Self-Organizing Aerial Swarm Robotics: A Table-Mechanics-Inspired Approach". Publishes the same per-drone reference wire format as mpc_planner, so the trackers are unchanged.
